query: What do Samsung Galaxy S9 buyers report about SIM activation, unlocking, and compatibility with their carrier?
search_text: What do buyers report about SIM activation, unlocking, and compatibility with their carrier?

rows.text: DO NOT BUY. Phone is advertised as "unlocked". Phone would not activate with Straight Talk using Verizon Towers. Straight talk stated they were unsure what the problem was unless it was still locked. Contacted the seller (Infitek) who took several days to respond with a code to unlock the phone. Phone never gave the option to enter the code. Purchased a new sim card and the phone will would not activate with carrier. Return the phone buy only option given UPS pickup with a message stating refund would be given within 7 days of receiving the item. Day 7 still no refund, contacted amazon who states it may take additional time. Will never purchase from this seller again.
Buyers Beware!. The phone I purchased in 2019 is a factory unlocked T-mobile not an international version phone which relocked after a couple years.

Phone locked to sprint can’t use. There quality of the phone was okay, functions fine. BUT when I inserted my T-Mobile SIM card the phone told me it’s locked to sprint. Note I have to jump through hoops to unlock it Now I can’t get ahold of the seller to return

Great Unlocked Phone (Works w/T-Mobile). After reading other reviews I decided to purchase this phone and it has worked flawlessly since I've recieved it. It is unlocked as stated, I am on the T-Mobile Network, so I can't say the same for all carriers. It shipped quickly and was packaged extremely well. The box even has a set of headphones inside. I haven't tried them yet as I am a fan of my Beats. However, I inserted my SIM card from my old phone(S7 edge) and had no issues switching everything over on my own. The phone prompts you on what to do. I inserted my SIM and then restarted it per the instructions and was good to go. So far, I have not had any issues and I am loving all the features this phone has to offer. I am happy and satisfied with my purchase.

Overall a good buy.. Works well with my local carrier in Barbados. As soon as the local sim card was inserted it immediately downloaded their specs. However there are one or two apps which I could not uninstall, only allowed to disable because they were Verizon installed.
Not really unlocked. It says unlocked but in reality it is not. Does not support sprint.
Excellent Buy. Phone is unlocked and accepted our network sim with ease. No freezing, sticking, lagging, nothing. Great buy.

Was Not Fully Unlocked. Nice upgrade from my S7 & S8. Wasn't unlocked for Metro PCS/by T-Mobile but I called & Metro was able to use the IMEI to unlock it & switch my # to the new device. Metro didn't even charge me the $20 fee.

Great Service & New Compatible S9 As Advertised. I ordered this phone for my birthday. I've always wanted a Samsung Galaxy phone and after I accidentally dropped my previous iPhone I saw an excuse to get one. I had some reservations about purchasing the phone from a third party but I'm pleased to report that things seemed to turn out well. The phone arrived very fast. I ordered on Tuesday and the phone arrived by Friday. The phone was brand new and At&t compatible as advertised. I've been having alot of fun playing around with the new features for the past few days. It operates just as you'd expect of a new phone. I've had no issues. I'm thankful I was able to get it for such a price. I was originally going to pay $650 to Samsung directly. Customer service has also been great. The seller is fairly quick to respond to inquiries.

Mostly Ok. I brought this product from Breed used. The sim tray was damaged and there were scratches along the sides and top of the phone. However, the screen and camera were fine and the back was mostly undamaged. The delivery time was slow and it came in a strange box, but it came working smoothly and came network unlocked, which is what matters the most to me.

Phone is booted to AT&T and unable to be unlocked. This phone is advertised as unlocked and able to be used with Verizon. I tried to set it up as Verizon, the IMEI was not accepted. Took the phone to AT&T, as the phone has an AT&T logo screen. AT&T said the phone was never used in their system, but is booted to their system. Phone is not usable and not as advertised.
Does not work with all carriers as advertised. I bought this because the ad claimed this unit worked with all carriers. I have Verizon and unfortunately this turned out to be a waste of time.

Awesome, reputable seller! Great cust svc and products. Seller Wireless Cloud is exceptional! A lot of trust in your seller is necessary when purchasing a refurb, and he has proven to be extremely trustworthy and focused on customer satisfaction! The 1st refurbished Galaxy S9 I received from him was in perfect cosmetic condition and great working order with all applications, as described... except it had a problem reading the SIM and kept dropping me from the network... tried several carriers over 2 months with same results and found out it was a very rare manufacture flaw that would easily go undetected during the refurb process. By the time this was discovered, my window of return had officially expired. Fortunately, Mo was very responsive when I alerted him to this mysterious issue, supportive through the whole process, and happy to exchange it for me when it couldn't be fixed.

I did not like that it took long to charge and especially I hated that it took so long to turn on, first the t-mobile logo, then a black screen, then an hourglass, then a few more seconds to wait, it is too long! This phone is compatible with t-mobile and it says I have to call t-mobile to be able to unlock it. I don't know about the battery life because I didn't give it a chance. I am returning it.
Looks like new and unlocked. Great product! The phone is in great condition, works great and looks just like new! It was unlocked and able to be used on Boost mobile's network.

Covers all the bases I need. My old Galaxy had run its course. The price for this was right and all the reviews I read made the S9 sound like a solid choice. I am not disappointed. Condition of phone is practically new, unlocked so switching it to my carrier was easy and it arrived fast.

Limited feature version of S9. Needed to replace a Sony Xperia XZ Premium dual SIM phone that was stolen. Thought I'd try Samsung's new flagship phone, but still needed an unlocked dual SIM phone for my international business. Biggest complaint is that this model came from Europe (not the UK) and the firmware load is missing a couple of key features, mainly the ability to do WiFi calling. A huge miss and something that should have been disclosed by the seller. The GSM signal reception on this phone is extremely poor and drops calls with regularity. Combine that with the lack of WiFi calling and this phone is not worth the money.
No complaints.. Exactly what they said it was. A brand new unlocked Samsung galaxy S9. Put in my SIM card which is from St. Lucia and it worked right off the bat. No complaints.

Not wifi calling supported by ATT. I live in the suburbs of the fourth largest city in America. I signed up with this S9 + on ATT family plan . Sadly ATT's service, signal was zero bars in my neighborhood. I wondered why my new cellphone wouldn't pickup internet calling. After much time and troubleshooting, I found out Att does not support wifi calling on unlocked factory phones. Also the model isn't repurchase by Gazelle based on model number. very expensive mistake and disappointment to me Af .

Galaxy S9-best "new" Android phone under $500 in 2020. Purchased a New Galaxy S9 from Reliant Cellular to replace a previous S9 that my wife had for almost 2 years. Condition is new as advertised. Description stated AT&T locked so I thought it would be an original AT&T version. Phone is unlocked and IMEI number indicated phone was for Sprint. It did not have the programming for At&t loaded. Contacted seller. Jason was friendly and competent, and he let me bring the phone in to load the At&t programming. Wifi-calling and all other at&t features now work. Thanks! Best deal. IP68, Gorilla glass, fast processor etc... for under $500
